why: This is Artin's primitive root conjecture, still unresolved unconditionally as of 2026 per Wikipedia and multiple 2025-2026 papers, but there is a cluster of recent work (Goldmakher-Martin-Peringuey, Feb 2025, 'Refinements of Artin's primitive root conjecture'; Murty-Naik, Aug 2026, conditional proof via a non-abelian large sieve inequality) whose exact relationship to the stated unconditional question is unclear without reading them closely.
